description: EMT benchmark for a solid-state transformer through a fault on its LV DC port: its rectifier (a VSC's average-value model) holding its DC link from a 10 kV grid, its DC/DC stage (a dual active bridge's average-value model) holding its 800 V LV DC port, which feeds a 1 MW resistive load. simscape_emt_sst_benchmark.m builds it in Simscape, the controllers in a MATLAB Function block acting every dt, and tests/test_emt_sst.py builds it with Electrisim's solver and controllers, both from this file. SI units; phasors are amplitudes, phase a = cos(w t + angle).

grid.description: A three-phase source, star-grounded, behind R_g and L_g, L_g damped by R_p across it; filter capacitors c_f at the rectifier's AC bus, star-grounded.

rectifier.description: Averaged phase voltages, star-grounded, behind its reactor r, l; rated s_rated, its current limited to i_limit_pu; its DC link c_link held at v_dc, behind r_dc to the link bus; its carrier at f_sw, when it samples as in the study (not in the Simscape benchmark, whose controllers act every dt).

dab.description: A dual active bridge from the link bus (behind r_in) to its output capacitor (behind r_out to the LV DC bus): rated p_rated at its output's nominal v_out, efficiency eta, switching at f_sw (its leakage sized for its rating at 30 degrees), its output current limited to i_limit_pu either way, holding v_out; it blocks below block_pu of its input's or output's nominal voltage.

limited.description: A 0.4 ohm fault on the LV DC bus from t_on to t_off: the load and the fault together need more than the bridge's current limit, which holds the bus at some 0.92 pu; it recovers when the fault clears.

bolted.description: A 1 mohm fault on the LV DC bus at t_on: the bus collapses and the bridge blocks on undervoltage; the rectifier holds its link.
